app.title: Noise Filter
hint.virtualmic: Install VB-Cable, then select "CABLE Output" as the microphone in TeamTalk / Meet.
controls.title: Filter
model.none: No AI model installed yet. Connect to the internet once, or reinstall.
model.error: Could not load the AI model
model.checking: Checking for a newer AI model…
model.latest: You have the latest AI model ({v}).
contrib.title: Help the AI get better
contrib.body: We recorded {s:.1f} s of your room noise and found no voices in it. Send it to help train the next AI model? You can listen first.
contrib.consent: I agree to release this recording under CC0 (public domain) to train the Noise Filter AI. Only the audio, the noise type, the app version, the OS and a random installation ID are sent.
contrib.delete_confirm: Delete every noise sample sent from this PC?
contrib.thanks: Thank you! Your noise sample was sent.
contrib.record_tip: Stay quiet and let the room noise play (fan, AC, traffic…). Don't talk.
contrib.record_nomic: No microphone available. Choose one under Audio devices.
contrib.record_none: This recording can't be sent: {reason}. Try again in a quiet moment without voices.
contrib.file_body: "{name}": {n} clip(s), {s:.0f} s in total, passed the checks and contain no voices. Send them to help train the next AI model? The developer listens to every sample before it is used.
contrib.file_dropped: {n} other part(s) of the file were left out (voice, too quiet or clipped).
contrib.own_recording: I recorded this noise myself (not music, a video or a file from the internet) and it contains no voices.
contrib.file_none: No part of this file can be sent: {reason}. Only send room noise without voices or music.
contrib.file_err.unsupported: This audio file cannot be read. Use WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC or OGG.
contrib.file_err.too_long: The file is too long. Use at most 10 minutes of audio.
contrib.file_err.too_short: The file is too short. Use at least 2 seconds of noise.
device.title: Audio devices
settings.title: Settings
settings.tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.tray_tip: Closing the window hides it to the system tray (next to the clock) and the filter keeps working. Use "Quit" in the tray menu to exit.
settings.autostart_tip: Opens hidden in the tray every time you sign in to Windows.
settings.autostart_failed: Could not change the Windows startup setting
settings.resume: Turn the filter back on at launch
settings.resume_tip: If the filter was on when the app closed (or the PC shut down), it starts again automatically with the same devices.
tray.hidden: Noise Filter is still running in the tray. Right-click the icon and choose "Quit" to exit.
eq.hint: Drag a point to change frequency and gain, scroll over it to change Q (width). Double-click the graph to add a band. Tick several presets to combine them.
dyn.comp_tip: Evens out loud and quiet speech: levels above the threshold are reduced by the ratio, then the makeup gain lifts everything back up.
dyn.limiter_tip: The output never goes above the ceiling, so loud sounds do not distort. Adds no delay.
